rawFindings.title: Removing array value handling breaks multiple argument override behavior
rawFindings.explanation: The removed code handled the case where multiple options with the same name are passed, e.g., '--port 123 --port 456', which results in the argument being an array. The previous logic took the last value, effectively overriding earlier values. The new code assigns the possibly array-valued argument directly, which breaks this behavior and leads to incorrect option values.
rawFindings.suggestion: Restore the original handling for array arguments by checking if argv[name] is an array and assigning the last value to options, to maintain correct behavior with multiple options of the same name.
